name: Reverb FX: Chorus I / II, Phaser, RAZR, Hall, Room, Plate
description: Hold TRACK + turn Reverb Size: Reverb -> Chorus I -> Chorus II -> Phaser -> RAZR -> Hall -> Room -> Plate.
Hall / Room / Plate: own algorithms in the style of the Dragonfly Reverbs (no code taken); Size = decay, Tone = damping.
device: Model:Cycles OS 1.13 (also a Model:Samples running it)
pattern: header byte 52: 0 Reverb, 1 Chorus I, 2 Chorus II, 3 Phaser, 4 RAZR, 5 Hall, 6 Room, 7 Plate
